data-canonical-src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20(experimental)-000000\" style=\"max-width: 100%;\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n  \u003ca href=\"https://docs.typesafe.ai\" data-canonical-src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/decisions-TypeSafe%20jev-8b5cf6\" style=\"max-width: 100%;\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n  \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff\"\u003e\u003cimg alt=\"Ruff\" src=\"https://camo.githubusercontent.com/d6c7524504b7d886a9d34c11f44b9d31b2de1a579325b42e932744c4575a063b/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f656e64706f696e743f75726c3d68747470733a2f2f7261772e67697468756275736572636f6e74656e742e636f6d2f61737472616c2d73682f727566662f6d61696e2f6173736574732f62616467652f76322e6a736f6e\" data-canonical-src=\"https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astral-sh/ruff/main/assets/badge/v2.json\" style=\"max-width: 100%;\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\n\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003etypesafe-computer-use\u003c/strong\u003e (jev for short) drives a Mac toward a goal you type in plain English,\nfor about a fiftieth of a cent per step. It reads the screen deterministically, asks a small\nclassifier which action comes next, and only calls a writing model when a text field genuinely\nneeds free text or the classifier has stopped and the screen needs reading.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eOne idea runs through it: the classifier picks, code decides facts, and the writer only writes\nfree text. Anything a model would have to work out (a date, whether a field is focused, whether\na URL is clean) is computed in code and handed over as state.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"clicker \u0026quot;go to techcrunch and take me to the checkout page for the cheapest tickets to their next upcoming event\u0026quot; --act\"\u003e\u003cpre class=\"notranslate\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eclicker \"go to techcrunch and take me to the checkout page for the cheapest tickets to their next upcoming event\" --act\n\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cblockquote\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBeta.\u003c/strong\u003e This is under heavy development. Expect rough edges, and expect settings and\nbehavior to change between 0.x \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/releases\"\u003ereleases\u003c/a\u003e.\nIt drives your real mouse and keyboard, so start with a dry run.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/blockquote\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eWhy a classifier\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-why-a-classifier\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Why a classifier\" href=\"#why-a-classifier\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFrontier-model computer use is capable and expensive: every step ships a screenshot and\nwaits several seconds for a plan. Most steps do not need a plan. They need one choice\nfrom a short list, made quickly and cheaply, with a confidence number you can gate on.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://docs.typesafe.ai\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eTypeSafe\u003c/a\u003e sells exactly that: a decision model that answers\na \u003ccode\u003eChoice\u003c/code\u003e over up to 255 options with a full probability distribution and a calibrated\nconfidence, in a few hundred milliseconds, with free output tokens. This project is a\ncomputer-use loop built around it.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eMeasured on the same screenshot and goal, one decision each:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cmarkdown-accessiblity-table\u003e\u003ctable\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003cth\u003e\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003cth\u003etypesafe (jev)\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003cth\u003eClaude Opus 5, bare screenshot\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003cth\u003emultiplier\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003einput tokens\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e4,882\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e4,785\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003esame\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003ecost per decision\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.0002\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.032\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e155x cheaper\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003ecost per decision, realistic loop with history\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.0002\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.035 to $0.08\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e170x to 390x cheaper\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003ecost per 12-step task\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.003\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e$0.40 to $0.90\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e130x to 300x cheaper\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003emodel latency\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e0.13 to 0.38 s\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e5.2 s\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e14x to 40x faster\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eend-to-end step, with capture and OCR\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eabout 1.5 s\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eabout 5.5 s\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e3.7x faster\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\u003c/markdown-accessiblity-table\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThe honest caveat: the big model read the event dates off the pixels and compared them\nunaided. The classifier needed the date parsing described in\n\u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/how-a-step-works.md\"\u003ehow a step works\u003c/a\u003e. Every piece of reasoning the frontier model\ndoes for free has to be rebuilt here as deterministic state.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eInstall\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-install\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Install\" href=\"#install\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003emacOS 14 or newer, Python 3.12 or newer, \u003ca href=\"https://docs.astral.sh/uv/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003euv\u003c/a\u003e. Windows 10 and 11\nare experimental; see \u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/windows.md\"\u003eWindows\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"git clone https://github.com/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use\ncd typesafe-computer-use\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env     # fill in the keys\"\u003e\u003cpre class=\"notranslate\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003egit clone https://github.com/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use\ncd typesafe-computer-use\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env     # fill in the keys\n\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cmarkdown-accessiblity-table\u003e\u003ctable\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003cth\u003evariable\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003cth\u003erequired\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003cth\u003epurpose\u003c/th\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eTYPESAFE_API_KEY\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eyes\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eevery decision\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eANTHROPIC_API_KEY\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eno\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003etype_text\u003c/code\u003e, writer-proposed URLs, and the final answer\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eCLICKER_EMAIL\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eno\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eenables the \u003ccode\u003etype_email\u003c/code\u003e action\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eCLICKER_BROWSER\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003eno\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003ctd\u003edefaults to \u003ccode\u003eGoogle Chrome\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\n\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\u003c/markdown-accessiblity-table\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e.env\u003c/code\u003e lives at the repo root and is read by every entry point (\u003ccode\u003eclicker\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eclicker-inspect\u003c/code\u003e).\nTo run the writer on another model or endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible\nserver), see \u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/writer-endpoints.md\"\u003ewriter endpoints\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eGrant your terminal \u003cstrong\u003eScreen Recording\u003c/strong\u003e and \u003cstrong\u003eAccessibility\u003c/strong\u003e in System Settings \u0026gt;\nPrivacy \u0026amp; Security. Without the first, captures are wallpaper. Without the second,\nsynthetic clicks are silently dropped, and \u003ccode\u003e--act\u003c/code\u003e refuses to start.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eFirst run\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-first-run\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: First run\" href=\"#first-run\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"uv run clicker \u0026quot;open the Playground\u0026quot;                 # dry run: one step, prints what it would do\nuv run clicker \u0026quot;open the Playground\u0026quot; --act           # drives the machine, up to 100 steps\nuv run clicker \u0026quot;log in\u0026quot; --act --steps 20 --delay 3   # longer and slower\nuv run clicker \u0026quot;log in\u0026quot; --act --handoffs 0           # the classifier alone: its first stop ends the run\nuv run clicker-inspect \u0026quot;any goal\u0026quot;                    # 3-2-1, capture, open the annotated screen + payload\"\u003e\u003cpre class=\"notranslate\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003euv run clicker \"open the Playground\"                 # dry run: one step, prints what it would do\nuv run clicker \"open the Playground\" --act           # drives the machine, up to 100 steps\nuv run clicker \"log in\" --act --steps 20 --delay 3   # longer and slower\nuv run clicker \"log in\" --act --handoffs 0           # the classifier alone: its first stop ends the run\nuv run clicker-inspect \"any goal\"                    # 3-2-1, capture, open the annotated screen + payload\n\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eClear the terminal first. It is on screen, so its text is OCR input.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo stop a live run, press Ctrl-C in the terminal or slam the mouse into the top-left corner of\nthe screen. The loop also stops itself on \u003ccode\u003edone\u003c/code\u003e, low confidence, a stall, or the step limit,\nand the writer then reads the screen and prints the answer. Every run writes\n\u003ccode\u003eruns/\u0026lt;timestamp\u0026gt;/\u003c/code\u003e, so a stall can be \u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/run-folder.md\"\u003ereplayed offline\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eHow a step works\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-how-a-step-works\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: How a step works\" href=\"#how-a-step-works\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003col dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe screen is read deterministically: Vision OCR on a crop of the frontmost window, plus the\nlabelled controls from the accessibility tree, which sees the icons OCR cannot.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eCode adds the facts: the date on any block and how far off it is, the row of a repeated\nlabel, the focused field, the app and URL, and the actions already tried on this screen.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eOne TypeSafe request answers three \u003ccode\u003eChoice\u003c/code\u003es: which kind of action, which item, which site.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThe action runs deterministically, the loop waits, and the next capture is the only witness\nof what it did.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eWhen the classifier stops, the writer reads the screen and answers, or hands the run back\nwith a focus (one move) or a question for you. It never picks an action.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThe full walk, with the OCR cost, the tree walk, the action space, and the stop rules, is in\n\u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/how-a-step-works.md\"\u003ehow a step works\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eBenchmark\u003c/h2\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-benchmark\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Benchmark\" href=\"#benchmark\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003ejev runs as an agent in \u003ca href=\"https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld-V2\"\u003eOSWorld\u003c/a\u003e, a benchmark of real\ndesktop tasks, beside OSWorld's own GPT agent on the same task. \u003ccode\u003escripts/osworld setup\u003c/code\u003e fetches\nOSWorld and installs jev beside it; \u003ccode\u003escripts/osworld run-jev chrome/\u0026lt;task id\u0026gt; --ocr rapidocr\u003c/code\u003e\nruns one task. It needs a Linux host with KVM; see \u003ca href=\"/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/osworld.md\"\u003eOSWorld\u003c/a\u003e for that and for\na one-command machine in Google </p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>typesafe-computer-use</strong> (jev for short) drives a Mac toward a goal you type in plain English,
for about a fiftieth of a cent per step. It reads the screen deterministically, asks a small
classifier which action comes next, and only calls a writing model when a text field genuinely
needs free text or the classifier has stopped and the screen needs reading.</p>
<p dir="auto">One idea runs through it: the classifier picks, code decides facts, and the writer only writes
free text. Anything a model would have to work out (a date, whether a field is focused, whether
a URL is clean) is computed in code and handed over as state.</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="clicker &quot;go to techcrunch and take me to the checkout page for the cheapest tickets to their next upcoming event&quot; --act"><pre class="notranslate"><code>clicker "go to techcrunch and take me to the checkout page for the cheapest tickets to their next upcoming event" --act
</code></pre></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Beta.</strong> This is under heavy development. Expect rough edges, and expect settings and
behavior to change between 0.x <a href="https://github.com/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/releases">releases</a>.
It drives your real mouse and keyboard, so start with a dry run.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why a classifier</h2><a id="user-content-why-a-classifier" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why a classifier" href="#why-a-classifier"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Frontier-model computer use is capable and expensive: every step ships a screenshot and
waits several seconds for a plan. Most steps do not need a plan. They need one choice
from a short list, made quickly and cheaply, with a confidence number you can gate on.</p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://docs.typesafe.ai" rel="nofollow">TypeSafe</a> sells exactly that: a decision model that answers
a <code>Choice</code> over up to 255 options with a full probability distribution and a calibrated
confidence, in a few hundred milliseconds, with free output tokens. This project is a
computer-use loop built around it.</p>
<p dir="auto">Measured on the same screenshot and goal, one decision each:</p>

<p dir="auto">The honest caveat: the big model read the event dates off the pixels and compared them
unaided. The classifier needed the date parsing described in
<a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/how-a-step-works.md">how a step works</a>. Every piece of reasoning the frontier model
does for free has to be rebuilt here as deterministic state.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Install</h2><a id="user-content-install" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Install" href="#install"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<p dir="auto"><code>.env</code> lives at the repo root and is read by every entry point (<code>clicker</code>, <code>clicker-inspect</code>).
To run the writer on another model or endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible
server), see <a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/writer-endpoints.md">writer endpoints</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Grant your terminal <strong>Screen Recording</strong> and <strong>Accessibility</strong> in System Settings &gt;
Privacy &amp; Security. Without the first, captures are wallpaper. Without the second,
synthetic clicks are silently dropped, and <code>--act</code> refuses to start.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">First run</h2><a id="user-content-first-run" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: First run" href="#first-run"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="uv run clicker &quot;open the Playground&quot;                 # dry run: one step, prints what it would do
uv run clicker &quot;open the Playground&quot; --act           # drives the machine, up to 100 steps
uv run clicker &quot;log in&quot; --act --steps 20 --delay 3   # longer and slower
uv run clicker &quot;log in&quot; --act --handoffs 0           # the classifier alone: its first stop ends the run
uv run clicker-inspect &quot;any goal&quot;                    # 3-2-1, capture, open the annotated screen + payload"><pre class="notranslate"><code>uv run clicker "open the Playground"                 # dry run: one step, prints what it would do
uv run clicker "open the Playground" --act           # drives the machine, up to 100 steps
uv run clicker "log in" --act --steps 20 --delay 3   # longer and slower
uv run clicker "log in" --act --handoffs 0           # the classifier alone: its first stop ends the run
uv run clicker-inspect "any goal"                    # 3-2-1, capture, open the annotated screen + payload

<p dir="auto">Clear the terminal first. It is on screen, so its text is OCR input.</p>
<p dir="auto">To stop a live run, press Ctrl-C in the terminal or slam the mouse into the top-left corner of
the screen. The loop also stops itself on <code>done</code>, low confidence, a stall, or the step limit,
and the writer then reads the screen and prints the answer. Every run writes
<code>runs/&lt;timestamp&gt;/</code>, so a stall can be <a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/run-folder.md">replayed offline</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How a step works</h2><a id="user-content-how-a-step-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How a step works" href="#how-a-step-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>The screen is read deterministically: Vision OCR on a crop of the frontmost window, plus the
labelled controls from the accessibility tree, which sees the icons OCR cannot.</li>
<li>Code adds the facts: the date on any block and how far off it is, the row of a repeated
label, the focused field, the app and URL, and the actions already tried on this screen.</li>
<li>One TypeSafe request answers three <code>Choice</code>s: which kind of action, which item, which site.</li>
<li>The action runs deterministically, the loop waits, and the next capture is the only witness
of what it did.</li>
<li>When the classifier stops, the writer reads the screen and answers, or hands the run back
with a focus (one move) or a question for you. It never picks an action.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">The full walk, with the OCR cost, the tree walk, the action space, and the stop rules, is in
<a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/how-a-step-works.md">how a step works</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Benchmark</h2><a id="user-content-benchmark" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Benchmark" href="#benchmark"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">jev runs as an agent in <a href="https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld-V2">OSWorld</a>, a benchmark of real
desktop tasks, beside OSWorld's own GPT agent on the same task. <code>scripts/osworld setup</code> fetches
OSWorld and installs jev beside it; <code>scripts/osworld run-jev chrome/&lt;task id&gt; --ocr rapidocr</code>
runs one task. It needs a Linux host with KVM; see <a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/docs/osworld.md">OSWorld</a> for that and for
a one-command machine in Google Cloud.</p>

<p dir="auto">Bug reports with a run folder attached are the most useful thing you can send. Before a pull
request, <code>uv run ruff check . &amp;&amp; uv run ruff format --check .</code> and <code>uv run pytest -q</code> must pass.
The ground rules, and how to write a scenario for a task the loop cannot do, are in
<a href="/awlevin/typesafe-computer-use/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md">CONTRIBUTING.md</a>.</p>
